The first three seconds decide whether a TikTok Shop video sells or gets scrolled past, and the hook is those three seconds. A good hook creates a reason to keep watching before the pitch ever arrives. Below are 18 UGC hook formulas that consistently earn attention, grouped by the psychology they use, with an example each you can hand to creators.

Curiosity hooks

1. The unexpected result. "I did not expect this to actually work." Sets up a payoff the viewer wants to see.

2. The open loop. "Wait until you see what happens at the end." Promises resolution later.

3. The secret. "Nobody selling [category] tells you this." Implies insider knowledge.

The stakes on those first seconds are real, because TikTok throttles distribution fast. Sellers notice it directly: "my product tagged videos do so poorly compared to my normal videos, like 10 views to 1000 views," one wrote in a widely-read r/TikTokshop thread (r/TikTokshop). A strong hook is how a shoppable video earns the early watch-through that keeps it from getting buried. These formulas exist to win that opening.

Problem hooks

4. Call out the pain. "If your [problem] keeps coming back, watch this."

5. The mistake. "You are using [product type] wrong, here is why."

6. The frustration. "I was about to give up on [goal] until this."

Proof hooks

7. The before and after. Show the transformation in the first frame.

8. The receipt. "30 days of using this, here are my real results."

9. The skeptic converted. "I did not believe the reviews either."

Social hooks

10. The trend tie-in. "Everyone on my FYP is buying this, so I tried it."

11. The recommendation. "My [friend/derm/trainer] told me to get this."

12. The sold-out. "This keeps selling out and now I get why."

Direct hooks

13. The bold claim. "This is the best [product] under $[price]." Back it up fast.

14. The comparison. "I tried the $[high] one and this $[low] one, here is the winner." See comparison prompts for the framing.

15. The demo. Start mid-use, no intro. Show it working immediately.

Personal hooks

16. The confession. "I was embarrassed about [problem], not anymore."

17. The routine. "Add this to your [daily routine], here is where it fits."

18. The gift angle. "Buying this for everyone I know this year."

How to use these

  • Give creators the formula, not the script. Hand them the hook idea and let their voice do the rest. Over-scripting kills the native feel the algorithm rewards. Put the hook in your creator brief.
  • Match hook to product. A skeptical-review hook fits a proof-heavy product; a demo hook fits something visual.
  • Test several. Different creators will land different hooks. Let organic tell you which ones convert, then amplify the winners with ads.

The takeaway

Hooks are the highest-leverage three seconds in TikTok Shop content. Give creators a menu of formulas, let them adapt in their own voice, and watch which hooks earn the watch-through that turns into sales.
